pr_title: typedefs: Cleanup unused macros and unnecessary checks
pr_body:
We now require a compiler with C++17 support, so we don't need to
check for features added to GCC 5 or Clang 3.2.

Clang builtin availability checks were unused anyway as Clang defines
`__GNUC__` as it's also a GNU C implementation.

Fixes #36986.

---

@punto- I checked the codebase for usage (or lack thereof) of the macros I removed, can you check if you actually rely on some of them in console ports?

issue_context.title: Should OFFSET_OF macro be removed?
issue_context.body:
This code dates from the first commit when godot was open sourced. It's actually unused.
Should we remove it? The language has [offsetof](https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/types/offsetof), what's wrong with it?
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/98cdf50a5591e7629bde7688ceda82b15bd9e858/core/typedefs.h#L73-L81

review_comments: I haven't actually double checked if this is still necessary nowadays. But I think any compiler that supports C11 should define `NULL` in `stddef.h` which we include above?
I plan to make a PR migrating from `NULL` to `nullptr` so I guess it will be removed anyway. I'm waiting for the display-server branch to be merged so my PR doesn't cause a lot of conflicts.

I was waiting similarly before doing this change, but if you want to work on it, I'll leave it to you for after the merge of the `display-server` branch.
Note that `clang-tidy` has a tool for that: https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/checks/modernize-use-nullptr.html
